findings.title: Keep contextual logging observable through the test logger
findings.body: TestLogger.FromContext returns a fresh, disconnected TestLogger on every call. LoggerMiddleware now writes its completion log through logger.FromContext(ctx).Info(...), so a TestLogger passed into the middleware never records those messages in its InfoLogs; they are recorded on an instance that is immediately discarded. Return the existing test logger or share its recording state with the contextual logger so callers and tests can still observe the logs.
